news.summaryTr: Sermaye piyasası işlemlerine ilişkin "fon" soruşturmasında kapsamında eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Adil Katılım Bankası ortaklarından Ali Paslı ve OMG Capital Advisors'tan Ömer Murat Gülkan tutuklama talebiyle, 4 şüpheli ise ev hapsi talebiyle hakimliğe sevk edildi.
news.articleText: Şüpheli listesine yeni isimler: Fon soruşturmasında 3 tutuklama, 4 ev hapsi talebi - Sermaye piyasası işlemlerine ilişkin "fon" soruşturmasında kapsamında eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Adil Katılım Bankası ortaklarından Ali Paslı ve OMG Capital Advisors'tan Ömer Murat Gülkan tutuklama talebiyle, 4 şüpheli ise ev hapsi talebiyle hakimliğe sevk edildi. - Bulls Yatırım, Ruzy Madencilik, Lydia Holding ve Maygold Otomotiv şirketlerinin Yönetim Kurulu Başkanları ise "konutu terk etmeme" şeklindeki adli kontrol istemiyle hakimliğe sevk edildi. Sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması kapsamında gözaltına alınan 7 şüpheliden 3'ü tutuklama talebiyle sulh ceza hakimliğine sevk edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca, sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturması devam ediyor. Soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınıp adliyeye sevk edilen OMG Capital Advisors Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Ömer Murat Gülkan, eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Bulls Yatırım Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Kemal Akkaya, Ruzy Madencilik Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Nureddin Çevik, Lydia Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Enver Çevik ile Adil Katılım Bankası ortaklarından Ali Paslı ve Maygold Otomotiv Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Ayhan Yazkan'ın savcılıktaki ifadeleri tamamlandı. Şüpheliler Yunus Arıncı, Ali Paslı ve Ömer Murat Gülkan tutuklama talebiyle sulh ceza hakimliğine sevk edildi. Diğer şüpheliler Enver Çevik, Nureddin Çevik, Kemal Akkaya ve Ayhan Yazkan ise "konutu terk etmeme" şeklindeki adli kontrol istemiyle hakimliğe gönderildi.

news.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
news.summary: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
news.summaryTr: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.
news.articleText: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave - Published The family of former US President John F Kennedy has sued to block construction of a triumphal arch that President Donald Trump plans to build in the nation's capital. Nine members of the political dynasty argue the 250ft (76m) structure would block the view of Kennedy's grave, as well as the graves of thousands of veterans buried at Arlington National Cemetery in Virginia. Last week, a US judge temporarily halted the project on the heels of a vote allowing construction to proceed. The White House said it was "unfortunate" to see that some members of the Kennedy family had joined litigation against an arch "intended to honor our heroes who rest in Arlington Cemetery". "The judiciary should not be abused to politicize a structure designed to unite our nation," White House spokesman Davis R Ingle said in a statement to the BBC. "We will continue making the case for this beautiful and fitting monument and are confident we will be fully vindicated as this litigation proceeds," he added. Last week the project won approval from the National Capital Planning Commission. But US District Judge Tanya Chutkan then ruled there should be a 14-day pause before any work can start on the arch as litigation plays out. The Kennedy family filed its complaint under a joint lawsuit brought by the state of Virginia and Washington DC seeking to block construction, arguing that the arch will damage "historically significant sightlines" if erected at the gateway of the cemetery. The plaintiffs include seven children of Robert and Ethel Kennedy, as well as their grandson - former Democrat congressman Joe Kennedy - and Ted Kennedy's son Edward Kennedy Jr. It does not include Trump cabinet official Robert F Kennedy Jr, who leads the Department of Health and Human Services. Their motion moves to intervene in two other lawsuits filed by conservationists and veterans seeking to halt the construction. They say the arch would be a "permanent denigration" of the gravesites and that the Kennedy offspring "would never again be able to appreciate both sites as they always have before, and as the Kennedy family always intended". The Kennedy family argues the structure "will permanently cast shadows over and damage historically significant sightlines to the existing gravesites and memorials established in the Kennedy family's honor" at the cemetery. The structure would also "fundamentally alter the experience of visiting the gravesites", including the memorials of hundreds of thousands of US veterans, the Kennedys said. The complaint said that the National Park Service and Interior Department authorised construction on 5 November 2026 without the necessary congressional approval. The so-called Arc de Trump is one of the president's efforts to remake the capital city and is meant to commemorate the country's 250th anniversary. Last year, he also added his name to the Kennedy Center, a major Washington DC cultural institution named in honour of JFK. Trump's name remained on the facade for six months until the addition was ruled illegal and removed. Related topics - Published21 May - Published25 September - Published4 days ago

news.summary: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

news.titleTr: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
news.summaryTr: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
news.articleText: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now - Published An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill. A majority of the House of Representatives agreed to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky - for now. In his first news briefing from the Pentagon in six months, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage". The bid to find the cabinet secretary guilty of misconduct and ultimately remove him from office was seen as a long shot as it could have required a number of other Republicans to defy President Donald Trump. Massie was the only Republican to vote against moving the resolution to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee on Tuesday. His effort failed in a 211-204 vote, with more than a dozen members, including 11 Democrats, missing the vote. The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress before Democrats take control in January. President Trump celebrated the vote in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED". "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth. After the vote, Massie said he "wasn't surprised" but "was disappointed", according to BBC's US media partner CBS. "My diagnosis of Congress is these people know what to do," he added. "They just can't bring themselves to do it, even when it would benefit them politically." Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process. The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power. Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year. The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers. House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail. In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval. The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated". Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations". "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said. He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels. But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause". Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February. He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration. Texas Senator Ted Cruz, a Republican, said on Tuesday he expected Hegseth to resign or be fired by Trump. - Published2 days ago

Massie was the only Republican to vote against moving the resolution to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee on Tuesday. His effort failed in a 211-204 vote, with more than a dozen members, including 11 Democrats, missing the vote. The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress before Democrats take control in January. President Trump celebrated the vote in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED". "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth. After the vote, Massie said he "wasn't surprised" but "was disappointed", according to BBC's US media partner CBS. "My diagnosis of Congress is these people know what to do," he added. "They just can't bring themselves to do it, even when it would benefit them politically." Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process. The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power. Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year. The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers. House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail. In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval. The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated". Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations". "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said. He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels. But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause". Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February. He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration. Texas Senator Ted Cruz, a Republican, said on Tuesday he expected Hegseth to resign or be fired by Trump. - Published2 days ago

news.title: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says
news.summary: The infamous 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by the El Salvador military which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says
news.summaryTr: The infamous 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by the El Salvador military which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.
news.articleText: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says - Published The headquarters of one of Haiti's largest crime gangs has been destroyed by El Salvador's military, the Salvadoran president has said. The infamous 400 Mawozo gang, which is known for kidnappings and intimidation tactics, was targeted in a ground and air attack at a complex on the outskirts of Haiti's capital, Port-au-Prince. It is El Salvador's first military action on a Haitian target since it deployed more than 2,000 soldiers there last month, as part of a mission to rescue four missing Salvadoran technicians. Haiti has been plagued by gang violence for years, with heavily armed groups controlling large parts of the capital, and beyond. El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele announced the news on X, external, boasting that most of the gang members fled without trying to fight. "We destroyed the house of [gang leader] Lanmò San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters," he wrote on Tuesday. The post was accompanied by video of several helicopters firing on a large complex, reportedly in the suburb of Croix-des-Bouquets, the gang's stronghold. As the helicopters circle above, dozens of people can be seen running out of the property, fleeing the strikes. Several media outlets have reported that as many as 20 people were killed, however that has not been confirmed by authorities. There has also been no official confirmation of the extent of the damage at the property, with Haitians questioning whether it has been destroyed or just damaged. The Miami Herald reports that the gang's leader, Wilson "Lanmò San Jou" Joseph, was not there at the time. The BBC has not been able to verify the video posted by Bukele, nor whether the property is indeed the gang's headquarters. Haiti's National Police drone task force was involved in the attack, supported by Salvadoran soldiers, the Miami Herald reports, citing several sources. Posting on X after the strikes, Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé thanked the Salvadoran military's commitment "in the fight against gangs", and said the two nations would keep working together, along with the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF), to "regain control of the territory and restore state authority". "THE GANGS WILL GET NO SLEEP!" he added. Some 2,000 Salvadoran soldiers were deployed to Haiti last month after four air force technicians were abducted at gunpoint while food shopping in October. El Salvador's right-wing president has vowed to bring the men home alive and warned the gang to release them immediately or face sustained pressure from his military. The four abducted men were working as part of the GSF, made up of troops from several nations, initially led by soldiers from Chad. President Bukele's move to send thousands of Salvadoran troops to Haiti has raised concerns, with critics saying they are not all working within the command structure of the GSF. It has raised questions about the operational legitimacy and legality of their actions in the Caribbean nation. Amnesty International has urged both countries to "ensure all operations conducted by Salvadoran forces in Haiti comply with international human rights law". Such concerns do not appear to phase Bukele, however, who continues to directly warn and target the gang leaders. The attack on the supposed gang headquarters seemingly came after a user on X had urged Bukele to attack the complex. "Where is that house? Give us the exact address, and we'll destroy it," he replied to the post, which has now been taken down, apparently for violating X's rules. The 400 Mawozo gang is the largest criminal organisation in Haiti, and known for kidnappings, extortion, murders and arms trafficking. Haiti is the poorest country in the Americas and remains largely under gang control. At least 5,700 people have been killed or injured there by gangs or during operations against them between 1 January and 11 September this year alone, the United Nations has said. El Salvador has recorded huge reductions in gang violence under President Bukele as part of a sweeping crackdown, and he has vowed to do the same in Haiti. However, human rights groups have argued that the way he has done it is unlawful, with the open-ended extension of emergency laws, the treatment of detainees in El Salvador's high-security mega-prison and the mass trials of alleged gang members. news.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
news.summary: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

news.titleTr: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
news.summaryTr: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.
news.articleText: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor - Published Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, is back in federal custody in Florida after allegedly removing his ankle monitor, according to court documents. Markle appeared before a federal magistrate judge in the Florida city of Tampa on Tuesday and was denied bond. Prosecutors say he removed the monitor early that morning. US Judge Lindsay S Griffin found on Tuesday that Markle had violated the conditions of his pretrial release, court documents show. Markle, who has denied possessing images of child sex abuse, was arrested in Florida last week and placed under house detention. He was also ordered to wear a location monitoring device. The BBC has contacted his representatives. Griffin described Markle's housing situation as "untenable", writing in the order revoking his pretrial release that "based on the lack of suitable housing, no condition or combination of conditions would reasonably assure the safety of any other person or the community and the defendant's appearance in court". He also ordered a medical evaluation for Markle and said he "must receive all necessary and prescribed medication unless discontinued by a physician". "Release conditions are court orders, not suggestions," Bill Essayli, the US attorney for Central California, wrote on X on Tuesday. "We will continue to prosecute this case to the fullest extent of the law," he added. Markle, 82, was first arrested last week after the FBI, acting on warrants, searched storage units in Los Angeles registered to him which he had rented since 2008, with the last payment being made in October this year, the DoJ said. Inside the units the FBI says agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material. Witnesses "positively identified" Markle in two of the images believed to contain child sex abuse material. In those images, the man pictured "appears to be in the age range of 30s to 40s", which suggests the alleged abuse dates back decades as Markle is currently 82 years old. Markle appeared in court last week following his arrest. No plea was taken during the appearance, which set several conditions for his pretrial release, including that he be kept in home detention. He is charged with one count of possessing indecent images of children, according to the DoJ. FBI director Kash Patel said last week that Markle "allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions". Markle has called the allegations "sick lies". He moved to the Philippines last year after he had a series of strokes, and lived in Cebu until May. He was reportedly learning to walk again in Florida after having his leg amputated. The duchess has been estranged from her father since 2018. The BBC understands she broke contact with him last year, telling him she and the authorities knew he had abused young girls. In a previously shared statement, Meghan confirmed the existence of the letter and wrote: "I am deeply distressed... my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed." She said she hoped it could be understood why she had largely cut off contact from her father and did "not allow him to have contact with our children". news.summaryTr: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.
news.articleText: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says - Published The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has announced charges against three Iran-backed operatives that it alleges were involved in a string of plots in the US and Europe. The DOJ said Iranian agents most recently "orchestrated a terrorist plot at an air force base in the United Kingdom", saying they were involved in the major incident in September near RAF Fairford in the UK, where US armed forces were stationed. One man, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national, is accused of communicating with contacts in the UK from a prison in New York where he is awaiting trial on previous charges. The other two are accused of doing the same from Iran. Iran has strongly denied any involvement in the RAF Fairford incident, which came to light when suspicious vans were reported near the base. Seven men have been arrested in the UK over the incident. Iranian Mohsen Mohajeri, Iraqi national Mohammad Ali al-Hassani and dual Iranian-Iraqi citizen Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi were charged in an indictment unsealed on Tuesday, the DOJ said. It accuses the trio of planning attacks in Europe that were carried out under the name of a purportedly new group with the pseudonym Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (The Islamic Movement of the People of the Right Hand - HAYI). news.title: 'They will kill you too': Sonia Gandhi's turbulent journey in Indian politics
news.summary: Sonia Gandhi's memoir revisits love, loss and political inheritance, offering a deeply personal defence of her family and its legacy.

news.titleTr: 'They will kill you too': Sonia Gandhi's turbulent journey in Indian politics
news.summaryTr: Sonia Gandhi's memoir revisits love, loss and political inheritance, offering a deeply personal defence of her family and its legacy.
news.articleText: 'They will kill you too': Sonia Gandhi's turbulent journey in Indian politics - Published On the morning of 31 October 1984, Sonia Gandhi was a young wife and mother, living in the prime minister's residence in Delhi. She was about to take a bath when she heard shots ring out in the garden. Her mother-in-law, Indira Gandhi, India's prime minister, had just left for her office in an adjoining building. Moments later, she would be assassinated by two of her Sikh bodyguards, in retaliation for the Indian army's storming of the Golden Temple in Amritsar, Sikhism's holiest shrine, earlier that year. The sound was like firecrackers, but "different". The children's nanny came pounding on the bathroom door, hysterical, pointing towards the garden. Sonia ran towards the path. A white Ambassador car was moving slowly towards her. Inside, Indira lay covered in blood, her sari stained, her eyes open, her face wearing what Sonia remembered as a look of surprise. "Mummy, Mummy," she tried to say. No words came. At the hospital, she waited for hours before a doctor's shake of the head told her what she feared. The ordeal did not end there. Rajiv Gandhi, her husband and the elder son of Indira Gandhi, summoned from a rally in West Bengal, arrived to tell her that party leaders wanted him to become prime minister. Sonia's response was fury and terror. "They will kill you; they will kill you, too!" she pleaded. Rajiv replied: "They will kill me anyway." That evening, as Indira's body lay at home, Rajiv was sworn in. It is one of the most searing passages in Belonging: A Journey of Love, Sonia Gandhi's new memoir: private devastation unfolding alongside the pressures of public life. The woman who had largely stayed away from politics was now married to India's prime minister, and would eventually find herself at the head of the Congress party, leading it through two general election victories and becoming one of the country's most consequential political figures. The passage also foreshadows another devastating loss. In 1991, Rajiv himself was assassinated. For Sonia, the years that followed were marked by retreat. At 19, a young woman from a small Italian town, she had met Rajiv, an Indian student, in England. Their relationship took her into a new country and family, and a close bond with Indira followed. India became home through her husband and her mother-in-law. After Rajiv's killing, even the public appearances required by the memorial trusts she headed became an ordeal. Before speeches, she feared tears would overwhelm her. When the Dalai Lama asked whether she felt vengeful towards her husband's killers, she answered, "No, I don't," and burst into sobs. Slowly, she writes, Rajiv became "a presence within me rather than a piercing absence". But grief returned at family milestones. At her son Rahul's Cambridge graduation in 1995, she and her children were overcome by the thought of how proud Rajiv would have been. Politics, meanwhile, was closing in. The Congress party, the political vehicle of her husband's family for generations, was losing cohesion and electoral ground. Senior leaders were defecting, and the calls for Sonia to step in were growing louder. She initially refused. She writes she had seen politics through Rajiv: its achievements, but also its "ambition and greed, hypocrisy and treachery". "I'd always disliked politics," she writes. It had taken first her mother-in-law, then "the love of my life, my children's father". Yet the party's decline began to feel personal. Walking past photographs of Indira and Rajiv, she was seized by "a mixture of pain and guilt". She feared that the forces they had fought to "protect India's pluralistic ethos" were gaining ground: a rising Hindu nationalism that, in her view, threatened the "secular and pluralistic vision" of India they had sought to defend. Congress leaders argued that without her, the party could splinter, leaving little to resist communal politics. The family name, she believed, carried an appeal beyond religion, caste, language and region. This, she says, was "the most compelling argument". Her doubts were also about her own credentials. How could an outsider occupy a position held by two formidable figures? At home, Rahul and Priyanka feared losing their mother as they had lost their grandmother and father. Before a New Year holiday, they extracted a promise: "Don't you do anything crazy while we're away." The "answer", she says, came through the Bhagavad Gita. Though not religious in adult life, Sonia arranged private lessons with a Sanskrit scholar in January 1997. They read the text verse by verse. She writes that its central message – to perform one's dharma, or duty, without attachment to the fruits of one's actions – eventually resolved her inner conflict. "I had the answer to my own doubts and questions. I had to step out and go where my duty called. And I did." The memoir's most dramatic political scene, however, comes seven years later, after Congress's 2004 election victory. Sonia had led the party's campaign. Sonia goes with Manmohan Singh to meet India's president at the presidential palace in Delhi and formally stake the Congress-led alliance's claim to form a government. Everyone assumes she will become prime minister. She says nothing. At home, she tells a senior aide she intends to refuse. Party workers gather at the gates; senior colleagues demand a meeting. "You fought the election, you led us," says one. "People believed in you. How can you let them down like this? Our workers will revolt. You think they'll accept another leader?" Alliance leaders arrive to persuade her. They surround her, she recalls, and one insists: "We will not take no for an answer." Overwhelmed, she murmurs "Theek hai" - all right. They take it as consent and begin congratulating her. Her children are appalled, she writes. Rahul storms in: "You said yes?" Her daughter Priyanka urges her not to be forced into a decision. Sonia writes she spends a long night arguing with herself, friends and family. The risk is not merely personal. She believes the main opposition Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) would continue to exploit her foreign birth and that accepting office would allow the controversy to "create havoc" and hurt the country. By morning she is clear. "I've made up my mind. I'm going to stick to my stand," she tells Rahul. She chooses Singh, a trained economist and a party member, instead, describing him as a man "above reproach", with a "deep and consummate understanding of governance". The book is at its most revealing when it turns from family memory to the India she believes has been lost. Sonia says that when she entered public life there was "a certain decency and decorum in parliamentary politics". Political attacks and harsh words were not new, but she sees a sharper appetite among those in power "to belittle and torment those who differ from them, to intimidate those they perceive as opponents". It is, she says, part of a wider international drift towards "a heartlessness that accompanies authoritarian regimes". Her portrait of prime minister Narendra Modi of the Hindu nationalist BJP is unusually direct. The two have had "practically no real contact", she writes, beyond formal greetings at parliamentary gatherings and occasional exchanges - "Theek hain, aap?" ("Are you all right?") - when she returned from hospital. "He tends to look away," she says, "avoiding eye contact." Modi's idea of India, she writes, was shaped by the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and "affirmed a fundamentalism in which his faith and culture superseded all others". His is an India of "hierarchy, order, and control"; hers is "an India against hegemony", standing for "inclusiveness, secularism, and social justice". There is a striking concession amid the polemic - she says she understood Modi's "discomfort with the ruling elite of our times". Sonia says she felt uneasy in Delhi's privileged drawing rooms, where political conversation seemed "very far removed from the reality of India". Modi's origins, she writes, "may not be as humble as his PR team" suggests, but he "had certainly worked his way to power within the RSS from an underprivileged world". It is a rare acknowledgement of the social distance between the Congress establishment and the electorate Modi came to represent. The memoir also offers some glimpses of Sonia's encounters with world leaders. She remembers Vladimir Putin as an "engaging personality" who took her on a boat ride in St Petersburg, pointing out monuments along the way. She says she was impressed by his grasp of geopolitics and his "determination to restore Russia to its former powerful status" - "long before the Ukraine war, a different era". A more amusing encounter involved France's Nicolas Sarkozy, who arrived in India in 2008 without his then partner Carla Bruni because they were unmarried. At a state banquet, the Indian vice-president's wife cheerfully grilled him about when he planned to marry her, whether he missed her and whether a date had been fixed. Sarkozy obligingly answered her questions while messaging Bruni on his phone. Belonging is not a neutral history. The Bofors gun scandal, which badly damaged Rajiv Gandhi's government and dogged the family for decades, gets a relatively brief treatment. The 502-page memoir is less forthcoming about the less flattering aspects of Congress's own record. Sonia has much to say about political corruption, hypocrisy and the decline of public standards under her opponents, but largely sidesteps the culture of patronage, cronyism and corruption that dogged Congress during its years in power. There is little reckoning, either, with the party's own share of responsibility for the erosion of public trust. She is at pains to defend the political inheritance of her husband and mother-in-law, even as the party they built has suffered a prolonged decline. The story she tells is as much about the costs of carrying that inheritance as it is about a woman who says she never wanted the life she ended up leading. That gives the memoir's final pages an unmistakable melancholy. Sonia, 79, is now a member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of parliament. Rahul, 55, is a four-term MP and leader of the opposition; Priyanka, 53, is also a member of parliament. Sonia says the challenge was to remain faithful to "a just and humane society", through pain and loss, victory and defeat, and the manoeuvring that politics demands. But she ends not with triumph, nor even with the assurance that history will vindicate her. "At this moment it seems to me that, although I tried my best, I didn't succeed in beating back the forces I'd set out to fight."

items.articleText: ABD enflasyonu Goldman Sachs'a revize getirdi: 2027'de daha şahin Fed beklentisi Goldman Sachs, ABD'de ekim enflasyonunun beklentileri aşmasının ardından Fed'e ilişkin faiz tahminlerini güncelledi. Banka, Aralık 2026'da 25 baz puanlık faiz artışı beklentisini korurken Mart 2027'de üçüncü bir artış daha öngördü. Eylül 2027'de başlamasını beklediği faiz indirimleriniyse erteledi. Goldman Sachs'tan üçüncü faiz artışı tahmini Goldman Sachs ekonomistleri, ekim ayı tüketici fiyat endeksinin (TÜFE) beklentilerin üzerinde gerçekleşmesinin Fed'in enflasyonla mücadele kapsamında ilave sıkılaştırmaya ihtiyaç duyabileceğini gösterdiğini belirtti. Banka, artık mevcut faiz artışı döngüsünde Mart 2027'de 25 baz puanlık üçüncü artışın yapılmasını bekliyor. Politika faizinde zirve yüzde 4,50 olabilir Goldman Sachs'ın tahminine göre, Mart 2027'de gerçekleşmesi beklenen faiz artışıyla ABD'de politika faizi yüzde 4,25-4,50 aralığına yükselecek. Böylece banka, faiz artışı döngüsünün daha önce öngörülenden uzun süreceğini tahmin ediyor. Aralık toplantısında üçüncü artış sinyali bekleniyor Goldman Sachs, son iki enflasyon verisinin Fed yetkililerinin faiz beklentilerini yukarı yönlü güncellemesine neden olacağını değerlendirdi. Banka ekonomistlerine göre, Aralık 2026 toplantısında açıklanacak faiz projeksiyonlarında üçüncü bir faiz artışına işaret edilmesi için Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) üyelerinden yalnızca ikisinin daha tahminini yükseltmesi yeterli olacak. items.summaryTr: ABD ile Çin arasındaki diplomatik temaslarda gözler gelecek haftaya çevrildi. ABD Hazine Bakanı Bessent'in açıklamasına göre, Çin ile ekonomik ilişkilerdeki gerilimlerin yanı sıra yapay zeka alanındaki riskleri de ele almak üzere yeni bir diyalog başlatılıyor.
items.articleText: Gözler ABD-Çin zirvesinde: Bessent'ten yapay zekada işbirliği mesajı - ABD ile Çin arasındaki diplomatik temaslarda gözler gelecek haftaya çevrildi. - ABD Hazine Bakanı Bessent'in açıklamasına göre, Çin ile ekonomik ilişkilerdeki gerilimlerin yanı sıra yapay zeka alanındaki riskleri de ele almak üzere yeni bir diyalog başlatılıyor. ABD Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent, ABD ile Çin'in yapay zeka alanındaki riskleri yönetmeye yönelik işbirliği yapacağını ancak bu alandaki çıkar farklılıkları konusunda yanılsamaya kapılmamaları gerektiğini ifade etti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bessent, ABD-Çin İlişkileri Ulusal Komitesinin gala yemeğinde yaptığı konuşmada, ABD'nin Çin ile arasındaki ticaret dengesizliğinin uzun süredir iki ülke arasında gerilim kaynağı olduğunu ifade etti. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın Çin'in ticaret uygulamalarına karşı kararlı adımlar attığını dile getiren Bessent, iki ülke arasındaki ekonomik ilişkilerin daha dengeli hale getirilmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Bessent, "Daha dengeli bir ilişkiye doğru ilerlerken hedefimiz, ayrışma değil, riskleri azaltmaktır." diye konuştu. ABD ekonomisinin onlarca yıldır yabancı tedarikçilere aşırı bağımlı hale geldiğini, Çin ekonomisinin ise giderek daha fazla dış talebe bağımlı olduğunu anlatan Bessent, ABD'nin tükettiği ürünlerin daha fazlasını üretmesi, Çin'in ise ürettiği ürünlerin daha fazlasını tüketmesinin gerektiğini savundu. Bessent, iki ülkenin birlikte çalışarak aralarındaki dengesizlikleri sürdürmeden ekonomilerini güçlendirebileceğini kaydetti. ABD'nin ekonomik gücü öncelik haline getirmesinin ticari ortaklarına yönelik bir düşmanlık anlamına gelmediğini vurgulayan Bessent, ticari ilişkilerde karşılıklılık ilkesini yeniden tesis etmeyi amaçladıklarını anlattı. "Doğrudan iletişim kanalı oluşturulacak" Bessent, ABD ve Çin'in yapay zeka alanında da yeni bir diyalog başlattığına değinerek, Trump'ın talimatıyla oluşturulan bu diyaloğun iki ülkenin sistemleri arasındaki yanlış anlamaları önlemeyi ve ortak riskleri yönetmeyi amaçladığını bildirdi. İleri yapay zeka modellerinin piyasaya sürülmeden önce değerlendirilmesi ve test edilmesi, insan denetiminin korunması ve yapay zeka modellerinin yol açabileceği ciddi olaylarda iki ülkenin birbirini hızla bilgilendirmesi konularında işbirliği yapılmasının öngörüldüğünü belirten Bessent, bu kapsamda doğrudan bir iletişim kanalı oluşturacaklarını kaydetti. Bessent, yapay zeka ilerledikçe, yeni risk yönetimi alanlarına yönelme ihtiyacının da artacağına işaret ederek, iki ülkenin rekabetin getirdiği talepler ile liderliğin getirdiği sorumlulukları nasıl dengeleyeceğini göstermelerinin gerekeceğini söyledi. ABD ve Çin arasındaki farklılıklar konusunda yanılsamaya kapılmamaları gerektiğini anlatan Bessent, "Çıkarlarımız her zaman örtüşmeyecek, her meseleye yaklaşımımız da her zaman aynı olmayacak." değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Liderler haftaya Çin'de bir araya gelecek Bessent, gelecek hafta ABD Başkanı Trump'ın Çin Devlet Başkanı Şi Cinping ile Shenzhen'de yapacağı görüşmeye eşlik edeceğini bildirdi. İki liderin Miami'de bu yılın dördüncü görüşmesini yapacağına işaret eden Bessent, "Trump ve Şi, ABD ile Çin'in denge ve karşılıklılık temelinde yapıcı bir ilişki kurmaları gerektiği konusunda hemfikirler." dedi.

items.articleText: Dolar endeksinde ABD enflasyonu fiyatlaması: 2 haftanın zirvesinde - ABD'de ekim ayı çekirdek enflasyonunun beklentileri aşması ve Fed yetkililerinin faiz artışlarını destekleyen açıklamaları, doların iki haftanın en yüksek seviyelerine yakın seyretmesini sağladı. - Piyasalar, Fed'in aralık toplantısında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımına gitme olasılığını yüzde 100'e yükseltirken, 50 baz puanlık artırım ihtimalini de fiyatlamaya başladı. ABD doları, beklenenden yüksek gelen enflasyon verileri ve Fed yetkililerinden gelen şahin açıklamaların ardından çarşamba günü kazanımlarını koruyarak iki haftanın en yüksek seviyesine yakın işlem gördü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Piyasalarda, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) aralık ayında faiz artıracağına yönelik beklentiler güçlenirken, daha yüksek oranlı bir artırım ihtimali de gündeme geldi. ABD dolarının altı büyük para birimi karşısındaki değerini ölçen dolar endeksi, 28 Ekim'den bu yana en yüksek seviyesine yakın 102,22 seviyesinde yatay seyretti. Endeks, ABD'de tüketici fiyatlarının ekim ayında gıda ve konaklama maliyetlerindeki artışın etkisiyle beklentilerin üzerinde yükseldiğini gösteren verilerin ardından salı günü yüzde 0,5 değer kazanmıştı. Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, Melbourne merkezli Pepperstone Group Araştırma Başkanı Chris Weston, faiz piyasalarının yalnızca bir faiz artırımını fiyatlamadığını belirterek, ABD para politikasının nihayetinde ne kadar sıkılaştırılması gerekebileceğinin sorgulandığını söyledi. Weston, bu tartışmanın riskli varlıklar açısından çok daha önemli hale geldiğini ifade etti. Piyasalar aralık ayında faiz artırımına hazırlanıyor Fed'in faiz belirleme komitesinde oy hakkı bulunan üyelerden gelen enflasyon uyarıları, faiz artırım beklentilerini daha da güçlendirdi. Yatırımcılar, Fed'in 9 Aralık'ta sona erecek bir sonraki para politikası toplantısında faizleri sabit tutacağı yönündeki beklentilerinden büyük ölçüde vazgeçti. CME Group'un FedWatch aracına göre, vadeli işlem piyasalarında aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımı olasılığı bir gün önceki yüzde 84 seviyesinden yüzde 91,9'a yükseldi. Faizlerin sabit tutulması ihtimali fiyatlamalardan çıkarken, 50 baz puanlık daha büyük bir artırım olasılığı yüzde 9,1 olarak hesaplandı. Piyasalar, ocak ayında ikinci bir faiz artırımı ihtimaline de yüzde 50'nin üzerinde olasılık veriyor. ABD'de ekim ayı çekirdek enflasyonu aylık bazda yüzde 0,3 olarak gerçekleşti. Böylece veri, yüzde 0,2 olan beklentiyi aştı. Fed Başkanı Christopher Waller, veriler açıklanmadan önce yaptığı değerlendirmede, çekirdek enflasyonun yüzde 0,3 gelmesinin aralık toplantısında 50 baz puanlık faiz artırımını değerlendirmesine yol açacağını söylemişti. Fed yetkililerinden daha fazla sıkılaştırma mesajı Dallas Fed Başkanı Lorie Logan, muhtemelen kısa sürede iki faiz artırımına daha ihtiyaç duyulacağını belirtti. Chicago Fed Başkanı Austan Goolsbee, ABD'de "gerçek bir enflasyon sorunu" bulunduğu uyarısında bulunurken, Philadelphia Fed Başkanı Anna Paulson ise kademeli faiz artırımlarından yana açıklama yaptı. Faiz vadeli işlemleri, aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık artırımın neredeyse kesinleştiğini, 50 baz puanlık artırım ihtimalinin ise yaklaşık yüzde 10 düzeyinde olduğunu gösterdi. Piyasalar, gelecek yılın ortasına kadar toplam üç adet 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımını da fiyatlamaya başladı. Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, Goldman Sachs ABD Başekonomisti David Mericle, Waller'ın açıklamalarına rağmen aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık ikinci bir faiz artırımı beklemeyi sürdürdüklerini söyledi. Mericle, Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) üyelerinin çoğunun doğrudan 50 baz puanlık artırıma geçmekte tereddüt edeceğini düşündüklerini belirtti. Mericle ayrıca Goldman Sachs'ın tahminlerine Mart 2027 için 25 baz puanlık üçüncü bir faiz artırımı eklediğini ve bunun federal fonlama faizini yüzde 4,25-4,5 aralığında zirveye taşıyacağını ifade etti. Küresel tahvil getirileri yükseldi ABD'deki yüksek enflasyon ve Fed'in şahin söylemi, küresel tahvil piyasalarında satış baskısını artırdı. ABD'nin 10 yıllık Hazine tahvilinin getirisi 13,8 baz puan yükselerek yüzde 4,996'ya çıktı. İki yıllık tahvilin getirisi ise gece boyunca 18 baz puan arttı. Asya piyasalarında da tahvil getirileri yükseldi. Japonya'nın 10 yıllık devlet tahvilinin getirisi 7 baz puan artışla yüzde 2,755'e, Avustralya'nın 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi ise 6 baz puan yükselişle yüzde 5,05'e ulaştı. Tahvil piyasalarındaki satışlara ve doların güçlü seyrine rağmen hisse senedi piyasaları dirençli kaldı. Euro, sterlin ve yen yatay seyretti Dolar karşısında euro 1,1168, sterlin ise 1,3345 seviyesinde yatay işlem gördü. Japon yeni karşısında da dolar 158,715 seviyesinde değişmedi.

CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Piyasalarda, ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) aralık ayında faiz artıracağına yönelik beklentiler güçlenirken, daha yüksek oranlı bir artırım ihtimali de gündeme geldi. ABD dolarının altı büyük para birimi karşısındaki değerini ölçen dolar endeksi, 28 Ekim'den bu yana en yüksek seviyesine yakın 102,22 seviyesinde yatay seyretti. Endeks, ABD'de tüketici fiyatlarının ekim ayında gıda ve konaklama maliyetlerindeki artışın etkisiyle beklentilerin üzerinde yükseldiğini gösteren verilerin ardından salı günü yüzde 0,5 değer kazanmıştı. Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, Melbourne merkezli Pepperstone Group Araştırma Başkanı Chris Weston, faiz piyasalarının yalnızca bir faiz artırımını fiyatlamadığını belirterek, ABD para politikasının nihayetinde ne kadar sıkılaştırılması gerekebileceğinin sorgulandığını söyledi. Weston, bu tartışmanın riskli varlıklar açısından çok daha önemli hale geldiğini ifade etti. Piyasalar aralık ayında faiz artırımına hazırlanıyor Fed'in faiz belirleme komitesinde oy hakkı bulunan üyelerden gelen enflasyon uyarıları, faiz artırım beklentilerini daha da güçlendirdi. Yatırımcılar, Fed'in 9 Aralık'ta sona erecek bir sonraki para politikası toplantısında faizleri sabit tutacağı yönündeki beklentilerinden büyük ölçüde vazgeçti. CME Group'un FedWatch aracına göre, vadeli işlem piyasalarında aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımı olasılığı bir gün önceki yüzde 84 seviyesinden yüzde 91,9'a yükseldi. Faizlerin sabit tutulması ihtimali fiyatlamalardan çıkarken, 50 baz puanlık daha büyük bir artırım olasılığı yüzde 9,1 olarak hesaplandı. Piyasalar, ocak ayında ikinci bir faiz artırımı ihtimaline de yüzde 50'nin üzerinde olasılık veriyor. ABD'de ekim ayı çekirdek enflasyonu aylık bazda yüzde 0,3 olarak gerçekleşti. Böylece veri, yüzde 0,2 olan beklentiyi aştı. Fed Başkanı Christopher Waller, veriler açıklanmadan önce yaptığı değerlendirmede, çekirdek enflasyonun yüzde 0,3 gelmesinin aralık toplantısında 50 baz puanlık faiz artırımını değerlendirmesine yol açacağını söylemişti. Fed yetkililerinden daha fazla sıkılaştırma mesajı Dallas Fed Başkanı Lorie Logan, muhtemelen kısa sürede iki faiz artırımına daha ihtiyaç duyulacağını belirtti. Chicago Fed Başkanı Austan Goolsbee, ABD'de "gerçek bir enflasyon sorunu" bulunduğu uyarısında bulunurken, Philadelphia Fed Başkanı Anna Paulson ise kademeli faiz artırımlarından yana açıklama yaptı. Faiz vadeli işlemleri, aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık artırımın neredeyse kesinleştiğini, 50 baz puanlık artırım ihtimalinin ise yaklaşık yüzde 10 düzeyinde olduğunu gösterdi. Piyasalar, gelecek yılın ortasına kadar toplam üç adet 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımını da fiyatlamaya başladı. Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, Goldman Sachs ABD Başekonomisti David Mericle, Waller'ın açıklamalarına rağmen aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık ikinci bir faiz artırımı beklemeyi sürdürdüklerini söyledi. Mericle, Federal Açık Piyasa Komitesi (FOMC) üyelerinin çoğunun doğrudan 50 baz puanlık artırıma geçmekte tereddüt edeceğini düşündüklerini belirtti. Mericle ayrıca Goldman Sachs'ın tahminlerine Mart 2027 için 25 baz puanlık üçüncü bir faiz artırımı eklediğini ve bunun federal fonlama faizini yüzde 4,25-4,5 aralığında zirveye taşıyacağını ifade etti. Küresel tahvil getirileri yükseldi ABD'deki yüksek enflasyon ve Fed'in şahin söylemi, küresel tahvil piyasalarında satış baskısını artırdı. ABD'nin 10 yıllık Hazine tahvilinin getirisi 13,8 baz puan yükselerek yüzde 4,996'ya çıktı. İki yıllık tahvilin getirisi ise gece boyunca 18 baz puan arttı. Asya piyasalarında da tahvil getirileri yükseldi. Japonya'nın 10 yıllık devlet tahvilinin getirisi 7 baz puan artışla yüzde 2,755'e, Avustralya'nın 10 yıllık tahvil getirisi ise 6 baz puan yükselişle yüzde 5,05'e ulaştı. Tahvil piyasalarındaki satışlara ve doların güçlü seyrine rağmen hisse senedi piyasaları dirençli kaldı. Euro, sterlin ve yen yatay seyretti Dolar karşısında euro 1,1168, sterlin ise 1,3345 seviyesinde yatay işlem gördü. Japon yeni karşısında da dolar 158,715 seviyesinde değişmedi.

items.articleText: Petrol fiyatları dipten döndü: Hürmüz Boğazı'nda yeni saldırılar Petrol fiyatları, İran'la savaşta ateşkes umutlarının güçlenmesiyle önceki seansta iki ayın en düşük seviyelerine geriledikten sonra Hürmüz Boğazı'nda gemilere yönelik saldırıların sürmesiyle yeniden yükseldi. Brent petrolün varil fiyatı 92 doların, ABD ham petrolü WTI ise 86 doların üzerine çıktı. Hürmüz'de gemi saldırıları rekor seviyeye ulaştı Washington Yakın Doğu Politikaları Enstitüsü'nün verilerine göre, Ekim ayında Hürmüz Boğazı ve çevresindeki su yollarında 37 gemi saldırıya uğradı. Bu sayı, savaşın başlangıcından bu yana kaydedilen en yüksek aylık saldırı sayısı oldu. Kasım ayında ise şu ana kadar 10 saldırı kaydedildi. Pazar günü sosyal medyada paylaşılan ve Reuters tarafından doğrulanan görüntülerde, Navig8 tankerinin Umman kıyısı yakınlarında alev aldığı görüldü. İran devlet televizyonuna göre tanker, Umman Boğazı'nda izinsiz güzergah kullandığı gerekçesiyle Pazar günü vurulan üç gemiden biriydi. Birleşik Krallık Deniz Ticaret Operasyonları (UKMTO), Salı günü yaptığı açıklamada Umman'ın Lima kentinin kuzeydoğusunda bir tankerin daha vurulduğunu bildirdi. İran Devrim Muhafızları Donanması ise ayrı bir açıklamada, Hürmüz Boğazı'ndaki izinsiz güzergah üzerinde deniz mayınlarına çarpan iki tankerin alev aldığını duyurdu. Ateşkes sağlansa bile petrol sevkiyatında risk sürecek Reuters'ta yer alan habere göre, LSEG analistleri, 10 Kasım tarihli değerlendirmelerinde, olası bir anlaşmanın Hürmüz Boğazı'ndan petrol akışını hemen normale döndürmeyebileceğini belirtti. Analistler, sevkiyatın artmasının mayın temizleme çalışmalarına, sigorta maliyetlerine ve gemi sahiplerinin risk alma isteğine bağlı olacağını kaydetti. Değerlendirmede, saldırıların yavaşlamadığı da vurgulandı. Petrol fiyatları önce geriledi, ardından kayıplarını telafi etti ABD'li yetkililerin İran'a karşı daha fazla askeri müdahaleye ihtiyaç olmadığını açıklamasının ardından petrol fiyatları önceki seansta varil başına 3 dolardan fazla geriledi. Ancak İranlı bir güvenlik yetkilisinin iki taraf arasında herhangi bir görüşme yapılmadığını açıklaması sonrasında fiyatlar kayıplarının bir bölümünü geri aldı. ABD'nin ham petrol stoklarında 9 milyon varillik artış Piyasa kaynaklarının Amerikan Petrol Enstitüsü (API) verilerine dayandırdığı bilgilere göre, 6 Kasım'da sona eren haftada ABD'nin ham petrol stokları 9 milyon varil arttı. Rusya ve Ukrayna Abu Dabi'de masaya oturdu Sektör kaynaklarına göre, Ukrayna'nın insansız hava aracı saldırılarını yeniden başlatmasının ardından Rusya'nın petrol rafineri kapasitesi Ekim ayının sonundan bu yana yaklaşık yüzde 30 azaldı. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın temsilcilerinin savaşı sona erdirmek için yeni bir girişim başlatmasının ardından Rus ve Ukraynalı yetkililer Salı günü Abu Dabi'de bir araya geldi. Görüşmeler, Şubat ayından bu yana iki ülke arasında gerçekleştirilen ilk barış temasları oldu.

items.summary: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

items.titleTr: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
items.summaryTr: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.
items.articleText: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site. Cross-chain bridge Across Protocol said it has regained control of its website after a social engineering attack on Tuesday enabled attackers to gain control of its domain, replacing its website with a phishing site. In a post on Wednesday, Across said the across.to domain is back under their control with help from Namecheap founder Richard Kirkendall, and that all systems are now working normally. “All affected users will be made whole. We’ll share a full post-mortem in the coming days,” the team said on X. The update follows Across’s Tuesday warning to users to avoid its app amid reports of drained wallets. The total losses and number of affected users have not yet been disclosed. Across attributes takeover to social engineering In an earlier update, Across said a social engineering attack on its domain registrar, Namecheap, gave an attacker control of its domain at approximately 18:45 UTC. The team said it was alerted within 15 minutes and immediately worked to shut the website down. Security response group SEAL911 helped flag the domain as phishing with major wallets, while Cloudflare marked it as at risk and later removed its DNS records. Some users who visited the domain before the malicious site was fully blocked may have been affected, the team said. Third-party integrations and API users were unaffected. The incident affected one of the largest cross-chain bridges by trading activity. Across ranked third by 30-day transfer volume, behind Circle and LayerZero, according to DefiLlama, having processed about $5.9 billion over the period. Related: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets

items.articleText: Altında toparlanma arayışı: Analistler fiyatları yükseltecek gelişmeye işaret etti Altın fiyatları, önceki seansta sert şekilde değer kaybetmesinin ardından yeni güne sınırlı yükselişle başladı. ABD’de ekim ayı enflasyonunun beklentilerin üzerinde gerçekleşmesi, Fed’in aralıkta faiz artırmasına kesin gözüyle bakılmasına neden oldu. Gelişme ile altın üzerindeki baskı devam etti. Altın fiyatlarında toparlanma sınırlı Spot altın, salı günü yaklaşık yüzde 3 gerileyerek ons başına 4.017,21 dolara kadar indi. Çarşamba günü kayıplarının bir bölümünü telafi etmeye çalışan altının yükselişi, ABD enflasyon verilerinin ardından faiz beklentilerinde yaşanan değişim nedeniyle sınırlı kaldı. Reuters’ta yer alan habere göre StoneX Kıdemli Piyasa Analisti Matt Simpson, salı günkü sert düşüşün ardından teknik bir düzeltme yaşandığını belirtti. Simpson, düşüş yönünde pozisyon alan yatırımcıların kârlarını realize ettiğini ve piyasanın yeni bir katalizör beklediğini söyledi. Analist, yüksek TÜFE verileri ve Fed yetkililerinin şahin açıklamalarının para politikasında sıkılaştırma beklentilerini yeniden güçlendirdiğini ifade etti. ABD'de enflasyon verisi fiyatlamayı etkiledi ABD’de ekim ayı enflasyonunun beklenenden hızlı yükseldiğini gösteren veriler, Fed’in gelecek ay faiz artıracağı beklentilerini güçlendirdi. Politika yapıcıların daha agresif bir sıkılaştırma yaklaşımına yönelebileceğine ilişkin değerlendirmeler de piyasalardaki faiz beklentilerini etkiledi. Fed’in aralık ayında faiz artırma olasılığı yüzde 100’e yükseldi CME FedWatch verilerine göre yatırımcılar, Fed’in aralık ayında faiz artırma olasılığını yüzde 100 olarak fiyatlamaya başladı. Enflasyon verileri açıklanmadan önce bu oran yüzde 84 seviyesindeydi. Yüksek faiz beklentisi altının cazibesini azaltıyor Altın, geleneksel olarak enflasyona karşı korunma aracı olarak görülse de faiz getirisi sağlamıyor. Faiz oranlarının yükselmesi veya yüksek kalmasının beklenmesi, altın tutmanın fırsat maliyetini artırarak değerli metalin yatırımcılar açısından cazibesini azaltıyor. Gözler Ortadoğu'dan gelecek daha fazla sakinleşmede ANZ Analisti Soni Kumari, Ortadoğu’da olumlu gelişmeler yaşanmasının enflasyon kanalı üzerinden altın fiyatlarını destekleyebileceğini belirtti. Bununla birlikte Kumari, genel makroekonomik görünümün kısa vadede altın açısından olumlu olmadığını söyledi. Gram altın 6.537 TL seviyesinde Küresel piyasalarda ons altının dolar cinsinden fiyatı ve dolar/TL kurunun ortak etkisiyle belirlenen gram altın, uluslararası piyasalardaki hareketlerin yanı sıra yurt içi altın piyasasındaki değişimleri de yansıtıyor. Gram altın, çarşamba günü TSİ 07.26 itibarıyla 6.491,77 TL alış ve 6.537,45 TL satış fiyatından işlem gördü.

Çarşamba günü kayıplarının bir bölümünü telafi etmeye çalışan altının yükselişi, ABD enflasyon verilerinin ardından faiz beklentilerinde yaşanan değişim nedeniyle sınırlı kaldı. Reuters’ta yer alan habere göre StoneX Kıdemli Piyasa Analisti Matt Simpson, salı günkü sert düşüşün ardından teknik bir düzeltme yaşandığını belirtti. Simpson, düşüş yönünde pozisyon alan yatırımcıların kârlarını realize ettiğini ve piyasanın yeni bir katalizör beklediğini söyledi. Analist, yüksek TÜFE verileri ve Fed yetkililerinin şahin açıklamalarının para politikasında sıkılaştırma beklentilerini yeniden güçlendirdiğini ifade etti. ABD'de enflasyon verisi fiyatlamayı etkiledi ABD’de ekim ayı enflasyonunun beklenenden hızlı yükseldiğini gösteren veriler, Fed’in gelecek ay faiz artıracağı beklentilerini güçlendirdi. Politika yapıcıların daha agresif bir sıkılaştırma yaklaşımına yönelebileceğine ilişkin değerlendirmeler de piyasalardaki faiz beklentilerini etkiledi. Fed’in aralık ayında faiz artırma olasılığı yüzde 100’e yükseldi CME FedWatch verilerine göre yatırımcılar, Fed’in aralık ayında faiz artırma olasılığını yüzde 100 olarak fiyatlamaya başladı. Enflasyon verileri açıklanmadan önce bu oran yüzde 84 seviyesindeydi. Yüksek faiz beklentisi altının cazibesini azaltıyor Altın, geleneksel olarak enflasyona karşı korunma aracı olarak görülse de faiz getirisi sağlamıyor. Faiz oranlarının yükselmesi veya yüksek kalmasının beklenmesi, altın tutmanın fırsat maliyetini artırarak değerli metalin yatırımcılar açısından cazibesini azaltıyor. Gözler Ortadoğu'dan gelecek daha fazla sakinleşmede ANZ Analisti Soni Kumari, Ortadoğu’da olumlu gelişmeler yaşanmasının enflasyon kanalı üzerinden altın fiyatlarını destekleyebileceğini belirtti. Bununla birlikte Kumari, genel makroekonomik görünümün kısa vadede altın açısından olumlu olmadığını söyledi. Gram altın 6.537 TL seviyesinde Küresel piyasalarda ons altının dolar cinsinden fiyatı ve dolar/TL kurunun ortak etkisiyle belirlenen gram altın, uluslararası piyasalardaki hareketlerin yanı sıra yurt içi altın piyasasındaki değişimleri de yansıtıyor. Gram altın, çarşamba günü TSİ 07.26 itibarıyla 6.491,77 TL alış ve 6.537,45 TL satış fiyatından işlem gördü.

items.articleText: Şüpheli listesine yeni isimler: Fon soruşturmasında 3 tutuklama, 4 ev hapsi talebi - Sermaye piyasası işlemlerine ilişkin "fon" soruşturmasında kapsamında eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Adil Katılım Bankası ortaklarından Ali Paslı ve OMG Capital Advisors'tan Ömer Murat Gülkan tutuklama talebiyle, 4 şüpheli ise ev hapsi talebiyle hakimliğe sevk edildi. - Bulls Yatırım, Ruzy Madencilik, Lydia Holding ve Maygold Otomotiv şirketlerinin Yönetim Kurulu Başkanları ise "konutu terk etmeme" şeklindeki adli kontrol istemiyle hakimliğe sevk edildi. Sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması kapsamında gözaltına alınan 7 şüpheliden 3'ü tutuklama talebiyle sulh ceza hakimliğine sevk edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca, sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturması devam ediyor. Soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınıp adliyeye sevk edilen OMG Capital Advisors Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Ömer Murat Gülkan, eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Bulls Yatırım Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Kemal Akkaya, Ruzy Madencilik Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Nureddin Çevik, Lydia Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Enver Çevik ile Adil Katılım Bankası ortaklarından Ali Paslı ve Maygold Otomotiv Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Ayhan Yazkan'ın savcılıktaki ifadeleri tamamlandı. Şüpheliler Yunus Arıncı, Ali Paslı ve Ömer Murat Gülkan tutuklama talebiyle sulh ceza hakimliğine sevk edildi. Diğer şüpheliler Enver Çevik, Nureddin Çevik, Kemal Akkaya ve Ayhan Yazkan ise "konutu terk etmeme" şeklindeki adli kontrol istemiyle hakimliğe gönderildi.

items.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
items.summary: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
items.summaryTr: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.
items.articleText: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave - Published The family of former US President John F Kennedy has sued to block construction of a triumphal arch that President Donald Trump plans to build in the nation's capital. Nine members of the political dynasty argue the 250ft (76m) structure would block the view of Kennedy's grave, as well as the graves of thousands of veterans buried at Arlington National Cemetery in Virginia. Last week, a US judge temporarily halted the project on the heels of a vote allowing construction to proceed. The White House said it was "unfortunate" to see that some members of the Kennedy family had joined litigation against an arch "intended to honor our heroes who rest in Arlington Cemetery". "The judiciary should not be abused to politicize a structure designed to unite our nation," White House spokesman Davis R Ingle said in a statement to the BBC. "We will continue making the case for this beautiful and fitting monument and are confident we will be fully vindicated as this litigation proceeds," he added. Last week the project won approval from the National Capital Planning Commission. But US District Judge Tanya Chutkan then ruled there should be a 14-day pause before any work can start on the arch as litigation plays out. The Kennedy family filed its complaint under a joint lawsuit brought by the state of Virginia and Washington DC seeking to block construction, arguing that the arch will damage "historically significant sightlines" if erected at the gateway of the cemetery. The plaintiffs include seven children of Robert and Ethel Kennedy, as well as their grandson - former Democrat congressman Joe Kennedy - and Ted Kennedy's son Edward Kennedy Jr. It does not include Trump cabinet official Robert F Kennedy Jr, who leads the Department of Health and Human Services. Their motion moves to intervene in two other lawsuits filed by conservationists and veterans seeking to halt the construction. They say the arch would be a "permanent denigration" of the gravesites and that the Kennedy offspring "would never again be able to appreciate both sites as they always have before, and as the Kennedy family always intended". The Kennedy family argues the structure "will permanently cast shadows over and damage historically significant sightlines to the existing gravesites and memorials established in the Kennedy family's honor" at the cemetery. The structure would also "fundamentally alter the experience of visiting the gravesites", including the memorials of hundreds of thousands of US veterans, the Kennedys said. The complaint said that the National Park Service and Interior Department authorised construction on 5 November 2026 without the necessary congressional approval. The so-called Arc de Trump is one of the president's efforts to remake the capital city and is meant to commemorate the country's 250th anniversary. Last year, he also added his name to the Kennedy Center, a major Washington DC cultural institution named in honour of JFK. Trump's name remained on the facade for six months until the addition was ruled illegal and removed. Related topics - Published21 May - Published25 September - Published4 days ago

items.titleTr: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
items.summaryTr: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
items.articleText: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now - Published An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill. A majority of the House of Representatives agreed to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky - for now. In his first news briefing from the Pentagon in six months, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage". The bid to find the cabinet secretary guilty of misconduct and ultimately remove him from office was seen as a long shot as it could have required a number of other Republicans to defy President Donald Trump. Massie was the only Republican to vote against moving the resolution to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee on Tuesday. His effort failed in a 211-204 vote, with more than a dozen members, including 11 Democrats, missing the vote. The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress before Democrats take control in January. President Trump celebrated the vote in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED". "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth. After the vote, Massie said he "wasn't surprised" but "was disappointed", according to BBC's US media partner CBS. "My diagnosis of Congress is these people know what to do," he added. "They just can't bring themselves to do it, even when it would benefit them politically." Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process. The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power. Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year. The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers. House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail. In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval. The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated". Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations". "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said. He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels. But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause". Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February. He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration. Texas Senator Ted Cruz, a Republican, said on Tuesday he expected Hegseth to resign or be fired by Trump. - Published2 days ago

items.titleTr: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says
items.summaryTr: The infamous 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by the El Salvador military which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.
items.articleText: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says - Published The headquarters of one of Haiti's largest crime gangs has been destroyed by El Salvador's military, the Salvadoran president has said. The infamous 400 Mawozo gang, which is known for kidnappings and intimidation tactics, was targeted in a ground and air attack at a complex on the outskirts of Haiti's capital, Port-au-Prince. It is El Salvador's first military action on a Haitian target since it deployed more than 2,000 soldiers there last month, as part of a mission to rescue four missing Salvadoran technicians. Haiti has been plagued by gang violence for years, with heavily armed groups controlling large parts of the capital, and beyond. El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele announced the news on X, external, boasting that most of the gang members fled without trying to fight. "We destroyed the house of [gang leader] Lanmò San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters," he wrote on Tuesday. The post was accompanied by video of several helicopters firing on a large complex, reportedly in the suburb of Croix-des-Bouquets, the gang's stronghold. As the helicopters circle above, dozens of people can be seen running out of the property, fleeing the strikes. Several media outlets have reported that as many as 20 people were killed, however that has not been confirmed by authorities. There has also been no official confirmation of the extent of the damage at the property, with Haitians questioning whether it has been destroyed or just damaged. The Miami Herald reports that the gang's leader, Wilson "Lanmò San Jou" Joseph, was not there at the time. The BBC has not been able to verify the video posted by Bukele, nor whether the property is indeed the gang's headquarters. Haiti's National Police drone task force was involved in the attack, supported by Salvadoran soldiers, the Miami Herald reports, citing several sources. Posting on X after the strikes, Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé thanked the Salvadoran military's commitment "in the fight against gangs", and said the two nations would keep working together, along with the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF), to "regain control of the territory and restore state authority". "THE GANGS WILL GET NO SLEEP!" he added. Some 2,000 Salvadoran soldiers were deployed to Haiti last month after four air force technicians were abducted at gunpoint while food shopping in October. El Salvador's right-wing president has vowed to bring the men home alive and warned the gang to release them immediately or face sustained pressure from his military. The four abducted men were working as part of the GSF, made up of troops from several nations, initially led by soldiers from Chad. President Bukele's move to send thousands of Salvadoran troops to Haiti has raised concerns, with critics saying they are not all working within the command structure of the GSF. It has raised questions about the operational legitimacy and legality of their actions in the Caribbean nation. Amnesty International has urged both countries to "ensure all operations conducted by Salvadoran forces in Haiti comply with international human rights law". Such concerns do not appear to phase Bukele, however, who continues to directly warn and target the gang leaders. The attack on the supposed gang headquarters seemingly came after a user on X had urged Bukele to attack the complex. "Where is that house? Give us the exact address, and we'll destroy it," he replied to the post, which has now been taken down, apparently for violating X's rules. The 400 Mawozo gang is the largest criminal organisation in Haiti, and known for kidnappings, extortion, murders and arms trafficking. Haiti is the poorest country in the Americas and remains largely under gang control. At least 5,700 people have been killed or injured there by gangs or during operations against them between 1 January and 11 September this year alone, the United Nations has said. El Salvador has recorded huge reductions in gang violence under President Bukele as part of a sweeping crackdown, and he has vowed to do the same in Haiti. However, human rights groups have argued that the way he has done it is unlawful, with the open-ended extension of emergency laws, the treatment of detainees in El Salvador's high-security mega-prison and the mass trials of alleged gang members. items.titleTr: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
items.summaryTr: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.
items.articleText: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor - Published Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, is back in federal custody in Florida after allegedly removing his ankle monitor, according to court documents. Markle appeared before a federal magistrate judge in the Florida city of Tampa on Tuesday and was denied bond. Prosecutors say he removed the monitor early that morning. US Judge Lindsay S Griffin found on Tuesday that Markle had violated the conditions of his pretrial release, court documents show. Markle, who has denied possessing images of child sex abuse, was arrested in Florida last week and placed under house detention. He was also ordered to wear a location monitoring device. The BBC has contacted his representatives. Griffin described Markle's housing situation as "untenable", writing in the order revoking his pretrial release that "based on the lack of suitable housing, no condition or combination of conditions would reasonably assure the safety of any other person or the community and the defendant's appearance in court". He also ordered a medical evaluation for Markle and said he "must receive all necessary and prescribed medication unless discontinued by a physician". "Release conditions are court orders, not suggestions," Bill Essayli, the US attorney for Central California, wrote on X on Tuesday. "We will continue to prosecute this case to the fullest extent of the law," he added. Markle, 82, was first arrested last week after the FBI, acting on warrants, searched storage units in Los Angeles registered to him which he had rented since 2008, with the last payment being made in October this year, the DoJ said. Inside the units the FBI says agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material. Witnesses "positively identified" Markle in two of the images believed to contain child sex abuse material. In those images, the man pictured "appears to be in the age range of 30s to 40s", which suggests the alleged abuse dates back decades as Markle is currently 82 years old. Markle appeared in court last week following his arrest. No plea was taken during the appearance, which set several conditions for his pretrial release, including that he be kept in home detention. He is charged with one count of possessing indecent images of children, according to the DoJ. FBI director Kash Patel said last week that Markle "allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions". Markle has called the allegations "sick lies". He moved to the Philippines last year after he had a series of strokes, and lived in Cebu until May. He was reportedly learning to walk again in Florida after having his leg amputated. The duchess has been estranged from her father since 2018. The BBC understands she broke contact with him last year, telling him she and the authorities knew he had abused young girls. In a previously shared statement, Meghan confirmed the existence of the letter and wrote: "I am deeply distressed... my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed." She said she hoped it could be understood why she had largely cut off contact from her father and did "not allow him to have contact with our children".
